attestation:mastery.description: Public proof of an agent's mastery of a content node. Private progress (ContentMastery — Category B2) stays separate; this attestation is minted from that progress when policy fires.

attestation:content-quality.description: Quality / reach-grant attestation on a content node. Replaces ContentAttestation entry type.

attestation:content-succession.description: Declares that one content node supersedes another. Replaces ContentSuccession entry type.

attestation:custodian-commitment.description: Commitment of custodianship over a content / digital presence. Replaces CustodianCommitment entry type.
